sprints.title: Load + inspect

tracks.title: Defensive Cybersecurity
tracks.project: Web Defense Lab — Blue Team vs Controlled Attack Traffic

sprints.title: Build the target web app
sprints.goal: Create a functional web application with at least one public route, one authenticated route and one intentionally expensive test route inside the isolated lab.
sprints.deliverable: Running local web app + architecture sketch + asset list

sprints.title: Instrument + baseline
sprints.goal: Add structured logs and measure requests per second, p95 latency, error rate and resource use before hostile traffic begins.
sprints.deliverable: Baseline report + UML V1 + trust boundaries

sprints.title: Controlled attack round 1
sprints.goal: Run the instructor-controlled HTTP flood profile against the internal target, record degradation and identify the bottleneck without changing the attack runner.

sprints.title: Availability defense
sprints.goal: Apply rate limiting, timeouts, connection/request limits and other justified controls, then repeat the exact same load profile.

sprints.title: Authentication + hostile inputs
sprints.goal: Defend fictitious accounts and test endpoints against controlled authentication abuse and malformed/oversized inputs while preserving legitimate access.
sprints.deliverable: Policy rules + validation tests + audit trail

sprints.title: Controlled attack round 2
sprints.goal: Execute the full authorized scenario suite without attacking external systems, and verify that defenses improve availability, latency, error rate and detection quality.

sprints.title: Hardening + recovery
sprints.goal: Reduce exposed state, tighten least privilege, improve observability and document a repeatable recovery procedure.

sprints.title: Live blue-team defense
sprints.goal: Defend the application live against an instructor-selected controlled profile, explain decisions from evidence and discuss residual risk.
sprints.deliverable: Live defense + final security report + UML + incident postmortem

sprints.title: Fusion onboarding + design brief
sprints.goal: Create/verify Autodesk access, identify the Fusion interface and parametric CAD concepts, complete the first dimension-driven part, then define the project dimensions and parameters.
sprints.deliverable: Fusion access verified + parametric keychain plate evidence + dimension sheet + MVP

sprints.title: Geometry objects + UML V1
sprints.goal: Model Shape, Solid, Transform and Assembly responsibilities and define the coordinate convention before expanding the CAD model.

sprints.title: Primitive generator
sprints.goal: Create parameter-driven base geometry.

sprints.title: OOP transformations
sprints.goal: Encapsulate translation, rotation, scale or extrusion behavior.

sprints.title: Composition
sprints.goal: Build a larger object from reusable parts.

sprints.title: Validation
sprints.goal: Reject invalid dimensions and verify geometric constraints.

sprints.title: Refactor + export
sprints.goal: Improve reuse and create a consistent export/render flow.

sprints.title: Demo + defense
sprints.goal: Change a parameter live and explain architecture.

sprints.title: System requirement
sprints.goal: Define sensor input, decision logic, actuator output and safety state.

sprints.title: Automation objects + UML V1
sprints.goal: Model Sensor, Controller, Actuator and System.

sprints.title: Simulation
sprints.goal: Simulate sensor readings and deterministic outputs before hardware.

sprints.title: OOP control layer
sprints.goal: Implement object responsibilities and controller behavior.

sprints.title: State machine + fail-safe
sprints.goal: Handle transitions, invalid readings and safe fallback.

sprints.title: Integration testing
sprints.goal: Test multiple input sequences and expected actuator responses.

sprints.title: Hardware/advanced simulation
sprints.goal: Connect target hardware when available or strengthen simulation.

sprints.title: Demo + defense
sprints.goal: Run scenario live and defend object/state architecture.
